Frequently Asked Questions (Etsy Fee Calculator)

Does Etsy charge the 6.5% transaction fee on shipping in 2026?

Yes. Etsy applies its 6.5% transaction fee to the total order amount paid by the buyer, including item price, buyer-paid shipping, and gift wrap (excluding US state sales tax collected by Etsy).

When are Etsy Offsite Ads mandatory?

Shops under $10,000 USD in rolling 365-day sales pay 15% on attributed orders and can opt out anytime. Once a shop crosses $10,000 in 12 months, Offsite Ads enrollment becomes permanent at a discounted 12% rate (capped at $100 per order).

How much do I save switching repeat buyers from Etsy to Shopify?

An organic US Etsy sale loses ~9.5% + $0.45 in combined platform and payment fees (or 21.5%+ with Offsite Ads), whereas Shopify Basic charges 0% marketplace commission and just 2.9% + $0.30 card processing.
